title: 3226. Number of Bit Changes to Make Two Integers Equal

examples.explanation: Initially, the binary representations of n and k are n = (1101)2 and k = (0100)2. We can change the first and fourth bits of n. The resulting integer is n = (0100)2 = k.
n and k are already equal, so no changes are needed.
It is not possible to make n equal to k.
